name: Northstar Apparel Company
old_description: Describe what your customers will receive when subscribing to your newsletter.
about:
Northstar Apparel Company is based in Hopkins, Minnesota. Public records do not disclose its founding year, ownership type, or the names of its founders.

The business offers custom apparel programs built around bulk ordering, online team stores, and design support. It produces decorated garments for clients and provides a pre‑production mockup for every order. The specific decoration methods—such as screen printing or embroidery—are not listed, nor are facility size, employee count, or annual production volumes.

Its customer base includes police departments, unions, special units, educational institutions, and corporate partners. The company cites an all‑school partnership from the past school year and professional apparel programs for law‑enforcement and special‑unit clients.

Northstar highlights personal service with no corporate runaround, quick response from its team, and a selection of premium and eco‑friendly apparel brands as its distinguishing features.
